result.instructions: Tools for IntakeQ, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes IntakeQ data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run intakeq_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run intakeq_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run intakeq_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. intakeq_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: intakeq_list_clients
tools.title: Search clients
tools.description: Search the practice's clients (patients) by name, email or client number, by created/updated date range, by external id, or by a custom field. Without include_profile it returns Name, Email, Phone and ClientNumber; with include_profile=true it returns the full profile (address, insurance, tags, custom fields, linked clients). Max 100 per page. IntakeQ: GET /clients.

search.description: Client name, email, or numeric client id.

include_profile.description: true = return the full client profile.

external_client_id.description: Look up by your external client id.

custom_fields.description: Match on custom fields: { "<FieldId>": "<value>" } (sent as custom.<FieldId>=<value>).

deleted_only.description: true = only clients deleted in the last 10 days.

page.description: Page number (1, 2, ...). Each page holds at most 100 records.

tools.name: intakeq_get_client_diagnoses
tools.title: Get a client's diagnoses
tools.description: List the diagnoses recorded for one client: code, description, start/end date and the treatment note they came from. IntakeQ: GET /client/{clientId}/diagnoses.

tools.name: intakeq_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: Query appointments by client name/email, date range, status, practitioner or last-modified date. Max 100 per page. IntakeQ: GET /appointments.

updated_since.description: Only appointments modified after this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

deleted_only.description: true = only appointments deleted in the last 10 days.

page.description: Page number (1, 2, ...). Each page holds at most 100 records.

tools.name: intakeq_get_appointment
tools.title: Get one appointment
tools.description: Fetch one appointment: client, practitioner, service, location, start/end, status, price, invoice, telehealth link and cancellation details. IntakeQ: GET /appointments/{id}.

tools.name: intakeq_get_booking_settings
tools.title: Get booking settings
tools.description: List the scheduler's locations, services (with duration and price) and practitioners — the ids you need to create an appointment. IntakeQ: GET /appointments/settings.

tools.name: intakeq_list_intakes
tools.title: List intake forms
tools.description: Query submitted intake questionnaires (summaries: client, status, questionnaire, practitioner, dates). By default only completed forms; set all=true for every status (Sent, Partial, Completed, Offline). Max 100 per page. IntakeQ: GET /intakes/summary.

external_client_id.description: Only intakes for this external client id.

updated_since.description: Only intakes updated after this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

all.description: true = return intakes of every status, not only completed.

deleted_only.description: true = only intakes deleted in the last 10 days.

page.description: Page number (1, 2, ...). Each page holds at most 100 records.

tools.name: intakeq_get_intake
tools.title: Get a full intake form
tools.description: Fetch one intake questionnaire with every question and answer, its consent forms and linked appointment. IntakeQ: GET /intakes/{id}.

tools.name: intakeq_list_questionnaires
tools.title: List questionnaire templates
tools.description: List the intake questionnaire templates in the account (id, name, archived, anonymous) — the ids you need to send one. IntakeQ: GET /questionnaires.

tools.name: intakeq_list_practitioners
tools.title: List practitioners
tools.description: List the practitioners in the account (id, name, email, external id). IntakeQ: GET /practitioners.

tools.name: intakeq_list_notes
tools.title: List treatment notes
tools.description: Query treatment note summaries by client, lock status, date range or last-updated date. Max 100 per page. IntakeQ: GET /notes/summary.

updated_since.description: Only notes updated after this date (yyyy-MM-dd).

deleted_only.description: true = only notes deleted in the last 10 days.

page.description: Page number (1, 2, ...). Each page holds at most 100 records.

tools.name: intakeq_get_note
tools.title: Get a full treatment note
tools.description: Fetch one treatment note with every question and answer and its linked appointment. IntakeQ: GET /notes/{id}.

tools.name: intakeq_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: Query invoices by client, issue date range, status, practitioner or last-updated range. Each invoice includes items, payments and amounts due/paid. Max 100 per page. IntakeQ: GET /invoices.

client_id.description: Only this client's invoices (numeric client id).

page.description: Page number (1, 2, ...). Each page holds at most 100 records.

tools.name: intakeq_get_invoice
tools.title: Get one invoice
tools.description: Fetch one invoice: line items, taxes, discounts, payments, totals and amount due. IntakeQ: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: intakeq_save_client
tools.title: Create or update a client
tools.description: Create a client, or update one. With ClientId the existing client is updated. WITHOUT ClientId IntakeQ still tries to match an existing client by first name + email (or first name + phone) and updates that one instead of creating a duplicate. For updates, fetch the full profile first (intakeq_list_clients with include_profile=true) and send it back with your changes, so no field is unintentionally cleared. Field names are IntakeQ's own. Dates are Unix timestamps in milliseconds. IntakeQ: POST /clients.

Address.description: Full address, or send the components below instead.

tools.name: intakeq_add_client_tag
tools.title: Tag a client
tools.description: Add a tag to a client. The tag is created if it does not exist; adding one the client already has is a no-op. IntakeQ: POST /clientTags.

tools.name: intakeq_create_appointment
tools.title: Create an appointment
tools.description: Book an appointment in the PracticeQ scheduler. Get PractitionerId, ServiceId and LocationId from intakeq_get_booking_settings. All fields are required by IntakeQ. Status must be Confirmed or WaitingConfirmation; SendClientEmailNotification may be true only when Status is Confirmed. IntakeQ: POST /appointments.

UtcDateTime.description: Start time as a UTC Unix timestamp in ms.

SendClientEmailNotification.description: Email the client (only allowed when Status=Confirmed).

ReminderType.description: Reminder channel: Sms, Email, Voice or OptOut.

tools.name: intakeq_update_appointment
tools.title: Update or reschedule an appointment
tools.description: Change an appointment's time, service, location, status or reminder type. Id and UtcDateTime are required (send the current time to keep it); include only the other fields you are changing. The client and practitioner cannot be changed, and a Confirmed appointment cannot go back to WaitingConfirmation. IntakeQ: PUT /appointments.

UtcDateTime.description: Start time as a UTC Unix timestamp in ms (required even if unchanged).

SendClientEmailNotification.description: Email the client about the change.

tools.name: intakeq_cancel_appointment
tools.title: Cancel an appointment
tools.description: Cancel an appointment, with an optional reason. This changes the client's booking and cannot be undone through the API — book a new appointment to replace it. IntakeQ: POST /appointments/cancellation.

tools.name: intakeq_send_questionnaire
tools.title: Send an intake questionnaire
tools.description: Send an intake questionnaire to a client by email or SMS. This MESSAGES THE CLIENT. Identify the client by ClientId, or by ClientName plus ClientEmail and/or ClientPhone (omit ClientEmail to force SMS). PractitionerId is optional. Returns the new intake. IntakeQ: POST /intakes/send.

ClientName.description: First and last name, if not using ClientId.

PractitionerId.description: Practitioner to associate; defaults to the client's.
